_doc: Lighting lives in the 64-byte per-profile 'func' block (read cmd 0x05 / write cmd 0x06 at offset 64*profile). Effect list from the layout JSON (lighting.effect). Same list for K68, K68_JIS, K68_Ultra_UK, K60, K60_1: true. Flags say which controls the UI enables for that effect; `direction` = which direction-control set (0 none,1 left/right,2 up/down,3 spread/gather,4 cw/ccw).

funcBlockLightingBytes.9: brightness (UI slider 0..100 step 1, written raw; brightness 'off' toggle writes 0)
funcBlockLightingBytes.10: speed stored INVERTED: byte = 4 - uiSpeed, uiSpeed 0..4 (marks 1..4)
funcBlockLightingBytes.11: direction (0/1, meaning depends on effect, see directionValues)
funcBlockLightingBytes.12: color mode: 0 = single user color (bytes 14..16), 1 = multicolor/rainbow (UI 'singleColor' = !byte12)
funcBlockLightingBytes.35: lightSleep: sleep timeout in units of 30 s (UI options 2=1min, 20=10min, 30=15min, 60=30min); UI clamps <2 to 2
funcBlockLightingBytes.36: lightSleep2: 1 = never sleep (UI writes byte35=0, byte36=1); 0 otherwise

perKey.storage: cmd 0x0A read / 0x0B write, 512 bytes per profile at offset 512*profile, 128 keys x [R,G,B] (only 384 bytes used); key index = protocol key index
perKey.liveColors: cmd 0xDE reads 384 bytes (128 x RGB) of the CURRENT rendered LED colors; the site polls it every 300 ms while on the light tab and effect != 0

palettePresets.note: UI 'Preset' dropdown (17015) writes these per-key color sets with setKeyColors(profile). key_code matched against default-keymap code to find the slot. For type 112 one extra slot (index 53) gets a preset-specific color.

unsolicited: Input report byte0=0xA1 (profile change) and 0xA3 (OS-mode change) carry the light bytes at [8..16] in the same layout as the func block.
